title: Create Wrench (3D Pottery)
description: Replaces the Miner Pottery Sherd with a 3D Wrench model from the Create mod.
body:
# Create Wrench 3D (Pottery Replacement)

This resource pack replaces the standard **Miner Pottery Sherd** with a detailed **3D model of the Wrench** from the famous **Create mod**. 

Now you can have the iconic wrench as a 3D item in your vanilla Minecraft world!

### Features:
* **Vanilla Compatible:** Works without any mods.
* **Custom Display:** Perfectly aligned in hands, GUI, and on the ground.

### How to obtain:
Use the following command to get the item:
`/give @s minecraft:miner_pottery_sherd`

---
**Credits:**
Original model and textures are created by the **Create Mod Team**. This is a fan-made port for vanilla Minecraft.
